At 173 cm long, there is plenty of room to stretch out. At 1.0 kg, it is light enough to carry and sturdy enough to stay put. Experience pilates mats the way they were meant to be.

name: Atlas Lite Hiking Backpack
description: Crafted with exceptional care, the Atlas Lite Hiking Backpack redefines lightweight hiking packs. With 35 L of space, packing for the day or the weekend is easy. Weighing only 0.8 kg, it keeps your load light on long days. With 9 pockets, everything has its place and nothing gets lost. Experience hiking backpacks the way they were meant to be.

name: Solis One Bedside Lamp
description: The Solis One Bedside Lamp brings understated elegance to bedside lamps. Up to 1200 lumens of light fills your space without harsh glare. Using only 12 W, it saves energy while keeping the room bright. Thanks to timer, using it is effortless. Own the Solis One Bedside Lamp and enjoy a standard in night lamps that few can match.

name: Luma Lite Insulated Water Bottle
description: The Luma Lite Insulated Water Bottle is here to make insulated water bottles your new favourite thing. A 750 ml capacity is just right for a day of sipping. Insulated to keep drinks hot for 12 hours, so the last sip is as good as the first. Made from 18/8 stainless steel, it is tough, safe and built for daily use. Treat yourself to reusable water bottles that bring a smile every single day!
